paper_metadata.title: Advanced creep life in a Ni-based superalloy through γ’ phase shape optimization with varying Al content

evidence.quote: Advanced creep life in a Ni-based superalloy through γ’ phase shape optimization with varying Al content

evidence.section: 3.1. The microstructure of the as-cast alloys
evidence.quote: The γ’ phase shape in the alloy changes from irregular circle and petal shape to a cubic type with regular shape as the Al content rises.
However, the cubic symmetry of the γ’ phase remains relatively low, and its morphology is nearly spherical.
The 5.7Al alloy has a γ’ phase with high cubicity and a uniform structure.
